annotations.title: Pair with an open Studio editor

description: Connects to the paywall editor a person has open, using the 6-character code shown under “Pair an agent” in the Studio. Returns a pairing_id for the editor_* tools. The code works once and for 10 minutes; a pairing lasts 24 hours or until either side stops it.
